items.title: The glueing functor restricts to equivalences on affine-over-X, closed immersions, and finite morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-pushouts.tex (Pushouts of Algebraic Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: (1) identify spaces affine over X with quasi-coherent O_X-algebras and the affine triples with algebra objects of QCoh(Y -> X, Z) (affine-equivalence lemma + relative Spec commuting with base change), so the module-level glueing proposition gives the equivalence; (2) full faithfulness from (1), essential surjectivity reduced (via (1)) to: X' -> X is a closed immersion iff both pullbacks to U and Y are - and {U -> X, Y -> X} is refined by an fpqc covering (lemma-dominate-by-fpqc-covering), so fpqc descent of closed immersions applies; (3) same argument with the finite-descent lemma.
